en: A single bolt of lightning is five times hotter than the visible surface of the Sun.
It takes nature up to 500 years to naturally form just one single inch of fertile topsoil.
Diamonds and the graphite in your pencil are both made of the exact same element, carbon.
A typical, medium-sized cumulus cloud can actually weigh more than one million pounds.
Jupiter's moon Europa has a subsurface ocean containing roughly twice as much water as all of Earth's oceans.
Neutron stars are incredibly dense, meaning a single teaspoon of their material would weigh about six billion tons.
Footprints left by Apollo astronauts on the Moon will remain perfectly visible for millions of years because there is no wind.
The 1883 eruption of Krakatoa was so incredibly loud that it ruptured the eardrums of sailors 40 miles away.
The massive 2004 Sumatra earthquake was so powerful that it slightly shifted the Earth's axis and shortened the day.
A single mature hurricane can release energy equivalent to 10,000 nuclear bombs exploding every single day.
Volcanic glass called obsidian can be fractured to create an edge much thinner than a modern surgical steel scalpel.
The Sun loses about four million tons of mass every single second by converting it into radiant energy.
